name: stars2
description: ClearWay AI root workspace runner and Vercel deployment config

scripts.build: cd clearway-ai && npx -y pnpm install && npx -y pnpm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('clearway-ai/dist/public')){fs.cpSync('clearway-ai/dist/public', 'dist', {recursive:true});}"
